description: This Java source file defines the List17 class, a ListActivity subclass that displays a list of cheese strings with an activated item highlighting feature. It initializes the list with a single selected item and updates the selection upon user clicks.

classes.name: List17
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that manages a list with activated item highlighting, initialized with a predefined set of cheese names.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the list view, sets the adapter, enables text filtering, sets choice mode to single, and activates the first list item.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks by marking the clicked item as checked/activated.
